description.text: The Starter Set VMAX Charizard deck as reissued on 4 December 2020 in the VMAX Battle Triple Starter Set, beside the new Venusaur VMAX and Blastoise VMAX decks. Some of its cards were changed from the March 2020 deck, Marnie taking the place of Cynthia. The set also held four holo promos (Genesect, Heatran, Suicune and Lugia), a playmat of its own, damage counters, markers and a card box, a Christmas gift for families.
